subject: Post-demo: Security follow-up, breach notification timelines & BCP/DR package request

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-demo: Security follow-up, breach notification timelines & BCP/DR package request

Hi Maya — thanks again for taking the demo yesterday. Quick recap and a short list of follow-ups from the security side so we can keep procurement moving: 

- Can you share the vendor security questionnaire you prefer we fill out? (PDF/Docx is fine)
- Please confirm whether HealthSpectrum requires HIPAA BAAs for initial POC data; if so, flag the key contacts.
- SOC 2 status — we are SOC 2 Type II (period ending Nov 2024); I can attach the summary and the SOC auditor contact for redaction/attestation purposes.
- Security ask: we typically provide a breach-notification timeline and a BCP/DR package on request. Can you confirm the acceptance window you need for those artifacts (e.g., within 5 business days)?

Attached: none for this note. If you can send the questionnaire I’ll loop in our security and SRE leads to expedite. Proposed next step: if convenient, a short slot next week for a security sync (30 minutes) — availability below.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

Availability: Wed 10:00-11:30 PT; Thu 14:00-16:00 PT
From: Maya Thompson <maya@healthspectrum.com>

Cc: Evan Liu <evan.liu@healthspectrum.com>
Date: Wed, 06 Aug 2025 09:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Security follow-up, breach notification timelines & BCP/DR package request

Hi Karthik — great demo, thanks. Attaching our standard vendor security questionnaire (att: HealthSpectrum_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf). A few clarifications from our side: 

- We do require HIPAA coverage for PHI processing; we can discuss scope but need to know if Redwood has prior BAAs in place.
- For breach notification: we need an initial acknowledgement within 24 hours, a preliminary incident brief within 48 hours, and a complete RCA and remediation plan within 10 business days for high-severity incidents. The procurement team may request evidence (runbooks, previous tabletop exercises).
- Please provide SOC 2 evidence and the auditor contact; our legal team will validate.

Can you have someone from security reach out to me directly? Also include a technical contact for log access requests.

Attachments: HealthSpectrum_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Maya Thompson
Senior Procurement Manager
HealthSpectrum
maya@healthspectrum.com | +1 (617) 555-3421
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Thompson <maya@healthspectrum.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 06 Aug 2025 11:35:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Security follow-up, breach notification timelines & BCP/DR package request

Thanks Maya — got the questionnaire. Looping in Neha (Security) and Sergio (SRE) who will own the artifact drop and technical answers. Quick answers and next steps below: 

1) SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II (coverage period through Nov 2024). Attaching high-level report summary for redaction: SOC2_Type2_2024_summary.pdf. Auditor contact: BrightLine LLP, attn: Rachel Kim (rachel.kim@brightline-llp.com).

2) HIPAA / BAA: We do execute BAAs. For POC-level data handling we can agree to a scoped BAA; legal (Marissa) will coordinate contract language.

3) Breach notification & IR timeline (proposed standard Redwood timeline):
   - Initial acknowledgement: within 24 hours of verified incident report
   - Preliminary incident brief & containment status: within 48 hours
   - Full RCA, remediation plan and timeline: within 5 business days for most incidents (10 business days for complex cross-region investigations)
   - Notifications to affected customers / data subjects: per applicable law (GDPR/HIPAA), typically within statutory windows — we’ll surface this per-case

  I’m attaching a draft timeline template (Draft_Breach_Timeline.xlsx) and a short SOC summary. These are intended to be starter artifacts we can populate with case-specific details. For procurement, we can provide excerpts of our BCP/DR runbook and the IR playbook under an NDA/secure transfer.

4) Technical/logs contact: Sergio will be the SRE lead for any log/export requests; he can coordinate secure log delivery and the required format. Sergio, can you confirm the approach (S3 pre-signed links vs. secure Share)?

Next steps:
- Neha / Sergio to review the questionnaire and send answers to Maya within 3 business days
- Legal (Marissa) to propose a scoped BAA and initial SOW language
- Karthik to schedule a 30-minute security sync (I’ll propose slots)

Attachments: SOC2_Type2_2024_summary.pdf (application/pdf), Draft_Breach_Timeline.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

- IR playbook excerpt (redacted): IR_Playbook_v2.docx — Neha
- BCP/DR runbook excerpt: BCP_Runbook_excerpt.pdf — Neha
- Recent tabletop exercise summary (2024): will pull notes and attendees — Neha
- Logs and S3 export process: Sergio owns secure export and pre-signed link rotation
- SOC 2 summary: Karthik attached a high-level PDF; I’ll coordinate auditor confirmation if legal needs direct contact

I’ll prepare a zipped package of redacted artifacts and upload to the secure share link Karthik suggested. Target: deliver package within 3 business days (by Fri EOD Aug 8). If HealthSpectrum needs earlier, tell me which specific items to prioritize.

Attachments (internal): none in this note; will follow with artifact upload.

-Neha

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Security follow-up, breach notification timelines & BCP/DR package request

Thanks for the quick turnaround. The proposed timeline looks good — we’ll accept an initial package by Fri if possible. Two asks before then: 

1) For log exports: we prefer S3 pre-signed links with AES-256 encryption in transit and at rest. Please have Sergio confirm the process (rotation window, retention policy).
2) For the BAA: our legal team will want a named Redwood contact for negotiation. Can Marissa be our point?

If you can confirm the above and drop the artifact package link when ready, we’ll route to legal and procurement immediately.

Appreciate it,
Maya
Senior Procurement Manager, HealthSpectrum
